name: DesktopSession
description:
The live desktop block: the target's screen with a state badge on it, the steps the
assistant took and is taking, and a large Stop. Stop and Take over are always reachable
while the AI holds the screen; nothing else in the conversation competes with them.
signature: ({ target, endpoint, state, user, userEntity, userIdentity, screen, steps, startedAt, reason, leaseEndsAt, pendingAction, onStop, onTakeOver, onResume, }: DesktopSessionProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: endpoint
props.description: The device or workspace being viewed, under its former name.

props.name: leaseEndsAt
props.description: Unix ms the control lease ends (counts down while controlling).

props.name: onResume
props.description: Called from Resume (`paused`) or Hand back to Assistant (`human`).

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called from Stop, shown in every state until the session has ended, expired or failed.

props.name: onTakeOver
props.description: Called from Take over, shown while the assistant is `controlling` or `awaiting-action`.

props.name: pendingAction
props.type: { label: string; effect: string; onApprove?: () => Promise<unknown>; onDeny?: () => Promise<unknown>; } | undefined
props.description: The consequential action waiting for approval (awaiting-action).

props.name: reason
props.description: Why it paused, failed or ended, one line.

props.name: screen
props.description: The latest frame. Its box keeps the frame's ratio, so frames never move the layout.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Unix ms the session started (the timer ticks while active).

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered steps representing the progress or reasoning sequence.

props.name: target
props.description: The device or workspace being viewed, as presentation data supplied by the host. Required unless the deprecated `endpoint` is given.

props.name: user
props.description: Who is signed in on the target ("AzureAD\\MiraRowan").

props.name: userEntity
props.description: Resolved signed-in person identity, rendered through the host entity adapter.

props.name: userIdentity
props.description: Host identity adapter, e.g. an account chip, when the signed-in value is a legacy account string.
